Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

Streets, schools and getting around East Burnaby

items.t: The quadrant runs from the Edmonds town centre and the Kingsway/Canada Way corridors east to the New Westminster border, taking in the Cariboo-Armstrong lands, Second Street, Twelfth Avenue and the Robert Burnaby Park lands.

Recreation anchors: the Rosemary Brown Recreation Centre at 7789 18th Street (2 NHL-size rinks) and the Edmonds Community Centre at 7433 Edmonds Street. The quadrant's library branch is the Tommy Douglas Library.
Planning frame: the Edmonds Community Plan was adopted in March 2025 — the current plan document for the town-centre part of the quadrant.
Transit: route 116 runs Metrotown–Edmonds via 18th Avenue and Griffiths Drive.

Schools in and beside the quadrant: Second Street Community Elementary (7502 2nd Street), Twelfth Avenue Elementary (7622 12th Avenue), Taylor Park Elementary (7590 Mission Avenue) and Cariboo Hill Secondary (8580 16th Avenue). Which of these fall inside the MLS "East Burnaby" line versus the Edmonds or Cariboo lines is not verified.
Where condo stock concentrates: the verified apartment listings for the SnapStats "East Burnaby" row are scattered singles, not a cluster.

Streets, schools and getting around East Burnaby

items.t: East Burnaby covers Burnaby's eastern side, from the Edmonds town centre and the Kingsway / Canada Way corridors east to the City of New Westminster border, taking in the Cariboo-Armstrong streets, the Second Street and Twelfth Avenue school neighbourhoods and the Robert Burnaby Park lands. Street-by-street boundaries for the MLS sub-area: Not verified — no City source read publishes them; the confirmed anchors are Edmonds, one of Burnaby's four town centres, at the west side, the New Westminster border at the east, and Robert Burnaby Park and Cariboo Hill in between.

Nearby areas: Edmonds and Highgate to the west and south-west, Cariboo and The Crest within the east side, South Slope to the south-west, and the City of New Westminster across 10th Avenue / the eastern border.

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: not in this row — the row is detached-heavy (see the market line below), and the quadrant's named townhouse complexes sit at the Edmonds / Highgate node under the Edmonds BE sub-area filing.

Burnaby is covered by SnapStats, but only as combined "Condos & Townhomes," never townhome-only, and medians are community-level only: Burnaby's combined median was $686,000 in September 2026 ($763/sqft, 98% sale-to-list, 36 days on market). No East Burnaby sub-area median exists.

Main roads: Canada Way, Kingsway, Edmonds Street and 10th Avenue run east–west, with 6th Street, 2nd Street and Cariboo Road running north–south. Transit: Edmonds Station (Expo Line) serves the area's west side, and route 116 runs between Metrotown Station and Edmonds Station via Imperial, Sussex, Marine Drive, Marine Way, Byrne Road, Southridge Drive, Griffiths Drive and 18th Avenue.

SD41 schools on the Province's list in or beside this broad area include Second Street Community Elementary (K–7), 7502 2nd St, Twelfth Avenue Elementary (K–7), 7622 12th Ave, Taylor Park Elementary (K–7), 7590 Mission Ave, and Cariboo Hill Secondary (8–12), 8580 16th Ave; which fall inside the MLS sub-area line versus the neighbouring Edmonds and Cariboo sub-areas is not verified.

Parks and anchors: Robert Burnaby Park is the east side's big park — many creeks and streams run through it and over half its area is critical wildlife habitat, with a City restoration project planting 3,000 new trees. Rosemary Brown Recreation Centre, 7789 18th Street, is at the area's south side; Edmonds Community Centre, 7433 Edmonds Street, is at the west edge; the Tommy Douglas Library serves this quadrant; the Edmonds Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at #201-7315 Edmonds St, and the city's hospital is Burnaby Hospital, 3935 Kincaid St.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in East Burnaby

items.t: : any townhouse a buyer actually purchases on the east side will almost always be an Edmonds BE strata purchase, so the strata package governs there: Form B Information Certificate under Strata Property Act s. 59 — monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Hazard check: creeks and streams run through Robert Burnaby Park and the ravine lands on the east side; a floodplain designation for East Burnaby's residential streets was not confirmed in the sources read, and parcel-level hazard, watercourse-setback and ALR status are property-specific checks — ALR status through the Agricultural Land Commission.

Property tax and utilities: City of Burnaby property taxes for 2026 were due Friday, July 3, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to outstanding current taxes (and to an unclaimed home owner grant) after the July due date, with a further 5% penalty after the September due date. There is no Vancouver Empty Homes Tax in Burnaby — that 3% tax is Vancouver only and never applies here.
